title: The rail maps: res/field/rails/maps.json
description: The rail maps' archive (a/1/1/0), one NoGridMapperHeader each (src/ov036/field_nogrid_mapper.c). ZONE_RAIL_ASSIGNMENTS in src/system/zonedata.c gives each zone with rails the index of its map here, and the map names the zone's rail file and its camera areas. tools/data/rail_data.py packs it.

rails.description: The rail file, a directory of res/field/rails/ in order.json, or null for none

camera_areas.description: The camera areas that LoadCameraDataToSceneAreaLoader loads, or null for none
